_doc: Advisory-job registry (sq-qcnn.32). [SONNET-4.6] Every job whose NAME matches the ci-summary exclusion pattern \b(advisory|informational)\b must have an entry here with {owner_bead, promotion_criteria, registered}. A job that intentionally runs a gate-classified script (scripts/*gate*.py) must also carry gate_script_waiver. Maintained by check-advisory-registry.py (C2/C3). See scripts/check-advisory-registry.py for the enforcement rule.

changed-code mutation review (advisory).promotion_criteria: promote only after the lane is stable across observed PRs, its runtime remains within the documented workload budget, and a reviewed allowlist mechanism exists for provably equivalent surviving mutants

secret-literal grep (advisory).promotion_criteria: advisory while the multi-cloud Terraform deploy templates are new; promote by moving the R4 secret-literal grep into a gating deploy-lint job once the deploy surface is proven stable on main

terraform validate (advisory).promotion_criteria: advisory while terraform validate runs credential-free across provider-version drift; promote by removing the (advisory) token once validate is proven stable on main across the pinned terraform_version

asan (mmap corruption corpus, informatio.promotion_criteria: MS-G3 memsafety gap (epic sq-toze) addressed and lane proven stable on main with sufficient green runs

new-bench-registry-dashboard (G3, adviso.promotion_criteria: G3 heuristic proven on real PR traffic with zero false-positives; promote by removing (advisory) token and --advisory flag

docs-quality quick-advisory (advisory).promotion_criteria: per-step (sq-6vshe.20 consolidation of the former markdownlint-advisory / vale / external-links jobs): a step promotes by MOVING into the quick-gates job — markdownlint-advisory once the whole-repo backlog (bench/, .claude/) is fully clean; vale once the prose-style backlog on README/skills/docs/crates is clean and the vale ruleset has settled; external-links never promotes (network-flaky by nature — dead external links must never block a merge)

mutation ratchet (cargo-mutants, advisor.promotion_criteria: sq-qcnn.27: all seeded ceilings pass --check AND sq-qcnn.29 nightly-fix (concurrency-cancel + sharding) is merged and seeded
mutation ratchet (cargo-mutants, advisor.gate_script_waiver: scripts/mutants-gate.py is the mutation ratchet checker itself, run advisory while the per-crate baseline is seeding (sq-qcnn.11); exits non-fatally until sq-qcnn.27 promotes it to gating

unsafe report (cargo-geiger, information.promotion_criteria: not promotable; cargo-geiger is too heavy/flaky for per-PR gating; the HARD gate is unsafe-register (sq-toze.6 / cert gap GX-5)

resolve nightly run config (advisory).promotion_criteria: never promotable; nightly workflows never gate the merge queue by design (sq-ymr2e.11)

a11y full sweep (chromium, advisory).promotion_criteria: never promotable; nightly workflows never gate the merge queue by design (sq-ymr2e.11)

visual full-surface sweep (container-pin.promotion_criteria: never promotable; nightly workflows never gate the merge queue by design (sq-ymr2e.11)

cross-browser P1 journeys firefox+webkit.promotion_criteria: never promotable; nightly workflows never gate the merge queue by design (sq-ymr2e.11)

tauri-driver GUI smoke Linux (advisory).promotion_criteria: never promotable; nightly workflows never gate the merge queue by design (sq-ymr2e.11)

tauri-driver GUI smoke ${{ matrix.os }}.promotion_criteria: never promotable; nightly workflows never gate the merge queue by design (sq-ymr2e.11)

route consolidated failures (advisory).promotion_criteria: never promotable; nightly workflows never gate the merge queue by design (sq-ymr2e.11)

GUI build + clippy (${{ matrix.label }},.promotion_criteria: sq-var9: macOS + Windows tauri-build matrix proven stable across main; remove advisory token

GUI tauri-driver e2e (Linux, advisory).promotion_criteria: advisory forever; real WebKitWebDriver + xvfb is environment-coupled by nature (E2E-GATING-POLICY.md §2)

GUI tauri-driver flake probe (Linux, adv.promotion_criteria: never promotable; workflow_dispatch flake probe only — not a PR check

kani ${{ matrix.suite.name }} (bounded p.promotion_criteria: bounded proofs are informational until a credentialed formal-methods review validates coverage (sq-hkud + epic sq-toze MS-G4)

conventional-commits (advisory).promotion_criteria: heuristic proven on real PR traffic with zero false-positives; remove advisory token (sq-v286.5 follow-up bead)

home hero-runner journeys (advisory).promotion_criteria: sq-ymr2e.12 probation bar: 50 consecutive green runs spanning at least 10 distinct PRs or two weeks, zero quarantine events (E2E-GATING-POLICY.md §3)

visual key layouts (container-pinned, ad.promotion_criteria: promotes last (E2E-GATING-POLICY.md §5): after all functional E2E lanes are stable on the sq-ymr2e.12 probation bar

determinism gate + foundation smoke (adv.promotion_criteria: sq-ymr2e.12 probation bar: 50 consecutive green runs spanning at least 10 distinct PRs or two weeks, zero quarantine events (E2E-GATING-POLICY.md §3)

Helm lint, render, and schema validation.promotion_criteria: advisory: the helm-validate job runs on push/PR (path-filtered to deploy/**), NOT merge_group, and installs network-fetched helm+kubeconform, so it must not gate the merge queue (a missing merge_group check otherwise fails ci-summary). Promote by running it on merge_group + removing the (advisory) token once proven non-flaky on main

fast-fix ring (advisory).promotion_criteria: not promotable to a gate: the ring runs post-hoc via workflow_run (on ci-summary completion), never on a PR/merge_group head commit, so it produces no gating check-run by design (sparq-org/sparq#3474 moved it here so the REGISTRY_RING_TOKEN doorbell is unreachable from PR-head content); it only notifies the registry doorbell after a gating-leg failure and must never gate a PR
